#Score Variables
```{r Score predictors}
# Lifetime AI mental-health support use
# Per the study denominator decision, missing Ai_support is counted as 0.
ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support == 1, 1, 0
)
ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use[
  is.na(ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use)
] <- 0

# PHQ-9
ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_total <- rowSums(
  ChatBots_DATA[, paste0("Depression_", 1:9)],
  na.rm = FALSE
)
ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_cutoff <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_total >= 10, 1, 0
)

# GAD-7
ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_total <- rowSums(
  ChatBots_DATA[, paste0("Anxiety_", 1:7)],
  na.rm = FALSE
)
ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_cutoff <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_total >= 8, 1, 0
)

# Psychiatric diagnosis history
# Retained for descriptives or other analyses; not in the final six-predictor models.
ChatBots_DATA <- ChatBots_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    MH_diagnosis_yes = case_when(
      Mental_health_diagnosis_a == 1 ~ 1,
      Mental_health_diagnosis_a == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# K6 psychological distress
ChatBots_DATA$K6_total <- rowSums(
  ChatBots_DATA[, paste0("Psychological_Distress_", 1:6)],
  na.rm = FALSE
)
ChatBots_DATA$K6_distress_recode <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$K6_total >= 5, 1, 0
)

# Loneliness: mean of all three items; higher = greater loneliness.
# A score is missing if any item is missing.
loneliness_items <- paste0("Loneliness_", 1:3)
ChatBots_DATA$Loneliness_mean <- rowMeans(
  ChatBots_DATA[, loneliness_items],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

# Unhappiness: reverse items 1–3; item 4 already points toward unhappiness.
# All scored items range from 1 to 7; higher = greater unhappiness.
ChatBots_DATA <- ChatBots_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    Happiness_1R = ifelse(
      Happiness_1 %in% 1:7, 8 - Happiness_1, NA_real_
    ),
    Happiness_2R = ifelse(
      Happiness_2 %in% 1:7, 8 - Happiness_2, NA_real_
    ),
    Happiness_3R = ifelse(
      Happiness_3 %in% 1:7, 8 - Happiness_3, NA_real_
    ),
    Happiness_4_unhappy = ifelse(
      Happiness_4 %in% 1:7, Happiness_4, NA_real_
    )
  )

unhappiness_items <- c(
  "Happiness_1R", "Happiness_2R",
  "Happiness_3R", "Happiness_4_unhappy"
)
ChatBots_DATA$Unhappiness_continuous <- rowMeans(
  ChatBots_DATA[, unhappiness_items],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

# WHO-5 poor well-being: raw total of 0–25; <=12 indicates poor well-being.
ChatBots_DATA$WHO5_total <- rowSums(
  ChatBots_DATA[, paste0("Well_being_", 1:5)],
  na.rm = FALSE
)
ChatBots_DATA$WHO5_poor <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$WHO5_total <= 12, 1, 0
)
```
```{r Score outcomes}
# Reasons for using AI for mental-health support
# 1 = selected; 0 = not selected; NA = not asked or missing
reason_vars <- paste0("Ai_support_function_m_", 1:8)

for (i in seq_along(reason_vars)) {
  ChatBots_DATA[[paste0("Reason_", i)]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    ChatBots_DATA[[reason_vars[i]]] == 1 ~ 1,
    ChatBots_DATA[[reason_vars[i]]] == 2 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

# Apply the final decisions for the 25 "other" responses.
# Dataset.Row refers to the row number in this specific source dataset.
other_reason_decisions <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(
  "MentalHealth_TextDATA/chatbot-mh_other-reasons_final-decisions.xlsx",
  sheet = "Other Responses",
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Dataset_Row = as.integer(Dataset.Row),
    Other_Response = as.character(Other.Response),
    Decision = as.character(Decision),
    Reason_Number = as.integer(sub("\\..*$", "", Decision))
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(other_reason_decisions) == 25,
  !anyDuplicated(other_reason_decisions$Dataset_Row),
  all(other_reason_decisions$Dataset_Row %in% seq_len(nrow(ChatBots_DATA))),
  all(other_reason_decisions$Reason_Number %in% 1:8),
  sum(other_reason_decisions$Reason_Number %in% 1:7) == 9,
  all(
    ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_8[
      other_reason_decisions$Dataset_Row
    ] == 1
  ),
  all(
    trimws(as.character(
      ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_t[
        other_reason_decisions$Dataset_Row
      ]
    )) ==
    trimws(other_reason_decisions$Other_Response)
  )
)

# Reassign nine "other" responses to their agreed reasons.
# Decisions of "8. Other" remain excluded from reasons 1–7.
for (i in 1:7) {
  recode_rows <- other_reason_decisions$Dataset_Row[
    other_reason_decisions$Reason_Number == i
  ]

  ChatBots_DATA[[paste0("Reason_", i)]][recode_rows] <- 1
}

table(other_reason_decisions$Decision, useNA = "ifany")

# Strategies for using AI for mental-health support
# 1 = used at least a little; 0 = not used at all;
# NA = not asked or missing
strategy_vars <- paste0("Ai_support_type_", 1:8)

for (i in seq_along(strategy_vars)) {
  ChatBots_DATA[[paste0("Strategy_", i)]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    ChatBots_DATA[[strategy_vars[i]]] == 1 ~ 0,
    ChatBots_DATA[[strategy_vars[i]]] %in% 2:4 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}
```

```{r Means and cronbachs alphas}
# Final continuous unhappiness score (higher = more unhappiness)
ChatBots_DATA$Unhappiness_continuous <- rowMeans(
  ChatBots_DATA[, c(
    "Happiness_1R", "Happiness_2R",
    "Happiness_3R", "Happiness_4_unhappy"
  )],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

# Full-sample weighted means and SDs
scale_design <- survey::svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~weight,
  data = ChatBots_DATA
)

for (score in c("Loneliness_mean", "Unhappiness_continuous")) {
  score_formula <- stats::as.formula(paste0("~", score))
  weighted_mean <- survey::svymean(score_formula, scale_design, na.rm = TRUE)
  weighted_variance <- survey::svyvar(score_formula, scale_design, na.rm = TRUE)

  cat(
    score,
    "| n =", sum(!is.na(ChatBots_DATA[[score]])),
    "| weighted mean =", round(as.numeric(coef(weighted_mean))[1], 2),
    "| weighted SD =", round(sqrt(as.numeric(weighted_variance)[1]), 2),
    "\n"
  )
}

# Conventional unweighted Cronbach alpha for the scored items
loneliness_items <- ChatBots_DATA[, c(
  "Loneliness_1", "Loneliness_2", "Loneliness_3"
)]
unhappiness_items <- ChatBots_DATA[, c(
  "Happiness_1R", "Happiness_2R",
  "Happiness_3R", "Happiness_4_unhappy"
)]

cat("Loneliness alpha =",
    round(psych::alpha(loneliness_items, check.keys = FALSE)$total$raw_alpha, 3),
    "\n")
cat("Unhappiness alpha =",
    round(psych::alpha(unhappiness_items, check.keys = FALSE)$total$raw_alpha, 3),
    "\n")

```

#Table 1: Prevalence for Reasons and Strategies
```{r Table 1 full-sample prevalence}
# Full-sample outcomes:
# 1 = endorsed the reason/strategy
# 0 = did not endorse it, or was coded as a nonuser
# NA = a user whose response to that specific item is missing

for (i in 1:7) {
  source_var <- paste0("Reason_", i)
  full_var <- paste0(source_var, "_full")

  ChatBots_DATA[[full_var]] <- ifelse(
    ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use == 0,
    0,
    ChatBots_DATA[[source_var]]
  )
}

for (i in 1:8) {
  source_var <- paste0("Strategy_", i)
  full_var <- paste0(source_var, "_full")

  ChatBots_DATA[[full_var]] <- ifelse(
    ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use == 0,
    0,
    ChatBots_DATA[[source_var]]
  )
}

# Rebuild the design so it contains the newly created _full outcomes.
design_full <- survey::svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~weight,
  data = ChatBots_DATA
)

# Rows in the order shown in manuscript Table 1.
table1_key <- data.frame(
  Group = c(rep("Reasons for use", 7), rep("Strategies used", 8)),
  Outcome = c(
    "Availability",
    "Less judgment",
    "More comfortable",
    "Guidance",
    "Easier than humans",
    "Cheaper than therapy",
    "Helps with loneliness",
    "Plan of action",
    "Find out more",
    "Advice",
    "Discuss feelings",
    "Let out emotions",
    "Emotional support",
    "Look for the good",
    "Understanding"
  ),
  Variable = c(
    "Reason_1_full",
    "Reason_2_full",
    "Reason_4_full",
    "Reason_6_full",
    "Reason_3_full",
    "Reason_7_full",
    "Reason_5_full",
    "Strategy_5_full",
    "Strategy_4_full",
    "Strategy_1_full",
    "Strategy_2_full",
    "Strategy_3_full",
    "Strategy_6_full",
    "Strategy_7_full",
    "Strategy_8_full"
  )
)

table1_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(table1_key)), function(i) {
    var <- table1_key$Variable[i]
    x <- ChatBots_DATA[[var]]

    estimate <- survey::svymean(
      stats::as.formula(paste0("~", var)),
      design_full,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    ci <- stats::confint(estimate)

    data.frame(
      Group = table1_key$Group[i],
      Outcome = table1_key$Outcome[i],
      N_available = sum(!is.na(x)),
      `n (raw %)` = sprintf(
        "%d (%.1f)",
        sum(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        100 * mean(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      `Weighted %` = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * coef(estimate)[1]),
      `95% CI` = sprintf(
        "%.1f–%.1f",
        100 * ci[1, 1],
        100 * ci[1, 2]
      ),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  })
)

print(table1_results, row.names = FALSE)
```

#Table 2: Reasons Regressions Models
```{r Table 2 regressions}
# Continuous predictors, using the final scoring
ChatBots_DATA$Unhappiness_continuous <- rowMeans(
  ChatBots_DATA[, c(
    "Happiness_1R", "Happiness_2R",
    "Happiness_3R", "Happiness_4_unhappy"
  )],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

# Refresh the survey design so it contains the final predictors
design_full <- survey::svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~weight,
  data = ChatBots_DATA
)

mental_health_predictors <- c(
  "PHQ9_cutoff",
  "GAD7_cutoff",
  "K6_distress_recode",
  "Loneliness_mean",
  "Unhappiness_continuous",
  "WHO5_poor"
)

covariates <- c(
  "age", "gender_model", "race_model",
  "educ_model", "Daily_SM_use"
)

reason_outcomes <- paste0("Reason_", 1:7, "_full")
strategy_outcomes <- paste0("Strategy_", 1:8, "_full")
all_outcomes <- c(reason_outcomes, strategy_outcomes)

fit_model <- function(outcome) {
  model_formula <- stats::reformulate(
    c(mental_health_predictors, covariates),
    response = outcome
  )

  survey::svyglm(
    model_formula,
    design = design_full,
    family = quasibinomial(),
    na.action = na.omit
  )
}

all_models <- setNames(
  lapply(all_outcomes, fit_model),
  all_outcomes
)

extract_focal_results <- function(model, outcome) {
  coefficient_table <- summary(model)$coefficients
  p_column <- grep("^Pr\\(", colnames(coefficient_table), value = TRUE)
  confidence_intervals <- confint(
    model,
    parm = mental_health_predictors,
    level = 0.95
  )

  data.frame(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Predictor = mental_health_predictors,
    N = nobs(model),
    aOR = exp(coefficient_table[
      mental_health_predictors, "Estimate"
    ]),
    CI_low = exp(confidence_intervals[
      mental_health_predictors, 1
    ]),
    CI_high = exp(confidence_intervals[
      mental_health_predictors, 2
    ]),
    p_raw = coefficient_table[
      mental_health_predictors, p_column
    ],
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

all_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(names(all_models), function(outcome) {
    extract_focal_results(all_models[[outcome]], outcome)
  })
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_BH = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
    Significant_BH = p_BH < 0.05
  )

# QA: exactly 15 models × 6 focal predictors = 90 tests
stopifnot(
  length(all_models) == 15,
  nrow(all_results) == 90,
  all(table(all_results$Outcome) == 6)
)

# Table 2, in manuscript column order
reason_order <- c(
  "Reason_1_full", # Availability
  "Reason_2_full", # Less judgment
  "Reason_3_full", # Easier than humans
  "Reason_4_full", # More comfortable
  "Reason_5_full", # Helps with loneliness
  "Reason_6_full", # Guidance
  "Reason_7_full"  # Cheaper than therapy
)

table2_results <- all_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(Outcome %in% reason_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = reason_order),
    Predictor = factor(
      Predictor,
      levels = mental_health_predictors,
      labels = c(
        "Depression", "Anxiety", "Psychological distress",
        "Loneliness", "Unhappiness", "Poor well-being"
      )
    ),
    Cell = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f); p%s",
      aOR, CI_low, CI_high,
      ifelse(p_BH < .001, "<.001",
             paste0("=", sprintf("%.3f", p_BH)))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Predictor, Outcome)

# Audit version: all 42 Table 2 associations
print(
  tibble::as_tibble(
    table2_results %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Predictor, Outcome, N, aOR, CI_low, CI_high,
        p_raw, p_BH, Significant_BH
      )
  ),
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)

# Manuscript-style layout
table2_display <- table2_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Predictor, Outcome, Cell) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Outcome,
    values_from = Cell
  )

print(tibble::as_tibble(table2_display), width = Inf)
```

#Variance Inflation Factor
```{r VIF}
vif_data <- ChatBots_DATA %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(c(mental_health_predictors, covariates))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

final_predictor_vif <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(mental_health_predictors, function(predictor) {
    auxiliary_model <- stats::lm(
      stats::reformulate(
        c(setdiff(mental_health_predictors, predictor), covariates),
        response = predictor
      ),
      data = vif_data
    )

    r_squared <- summary(auxiliary_model)$r.squared

    tibble::tibble(
      Predictor = predictor,
      N = stats::nobs(auxiliary_model),
      VIF = 1 / (1 - r_squared)
    )
  })
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(VIF))

print(final_predictor_vif)
range(final_predictor_vif$VIF)
```
